name: Ball check valve
function: A section below the grease head in which a ball is lifted onto a seat by well flow if the cable parts and is blown out of the head, sealing the bore and stopping flow to atmosphere.

tabs.overview: The ball sits below the seat while the cable is in the bore; a sudden upward flow after a cable blowout carries it onto the seat. It is reset after the event with the well shut in.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the stack; ball and seat sized to the bore.
tabs.safety: A blown cable is the event the ball check is for; personnel are already clear of the stack top when the string is moving.
tabs.evidence: Public pressure control equipment catalogs and service descriptions (S6, S7, S13); API RP 67 (S14) and API RP 19B (S15) for the perforating side; field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test the stack before opening the swab valve; bleed to zero before breaking any union.
